column3: You can sign up for a free thirty-day trial on their website. (你可以在他們的網站上註冊三十天的免費試用。)
Our company is seeking an experienced manager for the sales team. (我們公司正在為業務團隊尋找一位有經驗的主管。)
She answered every interview question with strong confidence and conviction. (她帶著堅定的自信與信念回答了每一個面試問題。)
The modern design of this smartphone has a wide appeal to young people. (這款智慧型手機的現代設計對年輕人很有吸引力。)
I must apologize for arriving late to our morning meeting. (我很抱歉早上的會議遲到了。)
Does this coffee shop accept credit cards or mobile payments? (這家咖啡店接受信用卡或行動支付嗎？)
Thank you for your sincere help during my first week at work. (謝謝你在我上班第一週給予的真誠協助。)
The airline will announce our departure gate in a few minutes. (航空公司會在幾分鐘內公布我們的登機門。)
This busy airport serves as a major hub for international flights. (這座繁忙的機場是國際航班的重要樞紐。)
Please call this number if you fail to open the electronic lock. (如果您無法打開電子鎖，請撥打此號碼。)
Moving to a foreign city for work can be an exciting challenge. (為了工作搬到國外城市可能是一個令人興奮的挑戰。)
You should get some professional legal advice before signing this rental contract. (在簽訂這份租賃合約之前，你應該先取得專業的法律諮詢。)
We have exhausted all our options to find a cheap hotel room. (我們已經用盡所有尋找平價飯店房間的辦法了。)
It is not polite to criticize your coworker's taste in clothing. (批評同事的穿衣品味是不禮貌的。)
The customer threatened to sue the store after slipping on the wet floor. (顧客在濕滑的地板上滑倒後威脅要起訴這家店。)
The manager promised to investigate the customer complaint right away. (經理承諾會立即調查這起客戶投訴。)
Please show your employee ID badge to the security guard at the door. (請向門口的警衛出示您的員工識別證。)
Sending a thank-you email after an interview is standard business practice. (面試後發送感謝信是標準的商務慣例。)
